title: Design System: SlipStream · Direction A · Slipstream

display-sentence.purpose: The system sentence on admin Flow; 23px phone; portal greeting 29px phone, 46px wide.

display-page.purpose: Every admin page head, one step below the sentence.

headline.purpose: Phone large titles (32px) and member portal titles (30px phone, 50px wide).

title.purpose: Section heads; counts follow at 450 weight in ink-3.

body-strong.purpose: Row titles in lists and tables.

label.purpose: Column heads and footnotes, sentence case.

label-rake.purpose: Tunnel rake names with tabular counts.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every other control.

shadows.name: live-head
shadows.purpose: Live path-strip head; fluorescein equivalent for ready.

motion.name: ease-flow
motion.purpose: Every state change, press, enter and flip.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons; icon buttons 0.96, rail and tab icons 0.94 and 0.9.

motion.name: flip
motion.purpose: Text that changes state in place.

motion.name: live-linear
motion.purpose: Progress, strip heads and meters tracking live values.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: fade 160 to 200ms; transforms and loops removed
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every motion above.

narrative.overview:
The admin reads SlipStream as a flow visualisation. The ground is near-black tunnel graphite; everything that moves is smoke. Each live job is a filament of smoke crossing six rakes (Wanted, Searching, Downloading, Moving, Importing, Library); its speed comes from its rate, its thickness from its size, and a failure lifts it off the line into a rhodamine vortex. The rest of the interface is a quiet instrument around that tunnel: monochrome smoke-white ink at four strengths, 1px hairlines, inset rings instead of borders, and three dyes held back for flow, separation and arrival.

Type does two jobs. Archivo, opened to its widest (125%) and lightest (300), writes the system sentence ("Five jobs are moving at 68 MB/s. Two need you.") and every page head; Archivo at normal width and medium weights carries the dense rows. Martian Mono, condensed to 87.5%, is kept for releases, paths and addresses. The density is that of a control room: 12.5 to 14px rows, tabular numerals, right-aligned rates, and generous 56px gutters between the two columns that sit under the tunnel.

Motion behaves like air: a single strong ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), presses that compress to 0.97, rows that change text in place with a short blur-and-rise rather than re-rendering, and continuous canvas motion only where work is actually moving. Reduced motion collapses every one of these to fades.
keyCharacteristics: Tunnel graphite ground in four tonal steps; no colour fills on chrome.
Smoke-white ink at 100 / 68 / 50 / 28% carries all hierarchy.
Three dyes, each with one meaning: light-sheet for flow and focus, rhodamine for separation, fluorescein for arrival.
Extended light Archivo for sentences and page heads; mono only for releases and paths.
The Tunnel and its filaments are the signature; the same painter draws a job at row scale.
Depth from inset 1px rings and one diffuse popover shadow; never hard shadows.

rules.name: The One Meaning per Dye Rule
rules.body: Light-sheet means flow or focus, rhodamine means something has separated from the flow, fluorescein means something has arrived. A dye that appears without that meaning is a defect.

rules.name: The Monochrome Canon Rule
rules.body: Outside the Tunnel, chrome is graphite and smoke. The contract budgets four dye uses per screen; the build stays near that (the admin home carries the rhodamine clause, two vortex glyphs and the fluorescein "1 new"). Artwork and member avatars (hsl at 22% saturation, 26% lightness, per-person hue) are content, not chrome, and sit outside the budget.

rules.name: The Stay-Marked Rule
rules.body: Arrivals carry a 6px ink-2 dot and brighter time until seen; failures keep their rhodamine glyph until resolved.

rules.name: The Two Stretches Rule
rules.body: Width is the hierarchy axis: 125% light for anything that reads as a sentence or a page name, 106 to 112% semibold for titles, 100% for everything in a row.

rules.name: The Literal Mono Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is set only on strings a machine would print: releases, paths, addresses. Words about a job stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live number uses tabular numerals so rates and percentages update without jitter.

rules.name: The Ring Not Border Rule
rules.body: Controls and containers are outlined with inset rings; 1px solid borders are kept for row dividers and structural seams (rail edge, top bar).

rules.name: The Light Marks Life Rule
rules.body: Glow is reserved for something live: a moving filament, a live strip head, an arrival. Static chrome never glows.

dos: **Do** let ink strength carry hierarchy: smoke ink, then 68%, 50% and 28%.
**Do** keep each dye to its one meaning: light-sheet for flow and focus, rhodamine for separation, fluorescein for arrival.
**Do** write state as a sentence in extended light Archivo (125% width, weight 300) before showing any number.
**Do** outline controls with inset 1px rings at 7 or 12% smoke, and save the pop shadow for floating layers.
**Do** set releases, paths and addresses in Martian Mono at 87.5% width, and everything else in Archivo.
**Do** draw job progress as a filament with the shared painter; keep the 2px hairline bar only for tasks that are not jobs.
**Do** use cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for state changes, scale presses to 0.94 to 0.97, and give every motion a fade fallback under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use rhodamine or fluorescein as decoration, emphasis or brand colour; they are reserved for separation and arrival.
**Don't** fill chrome with colour; graphite tones and smoke are the only chrome surfaces.
**Don't** add stat cards or a poster wall to Flow; the Tunnel and the sentence are its first viewport.
**Don't** use hard or offset shadows; depth is tonal, ringed, and diffuse.
**Don't** set labels or headings in uppercase or as small tracked kickers; labels are sentence case at 12px/500.
**Don't** set words below 10.5px; the only smaller type is the count inside a 15px ink badge pill (9.5px, weight 650).
